title: autorekt — make your AI a Wall Street analyst
description: An open-source CLI that hands your AI agent prices, dollar liquidity, swap spreads, positioning, options gamma, China's money markets, prediction-market odds and news as compact text, plus rules that wake it when something happens.
og_description: Models are already geniuses in a data center. autorekt gives them the data: every asset class, liquidity, positioning and odds, as text an agent can read.
note: Real output of autorekt show on November 5, 2026. Scroll inside the box for the whole briefing.
disclaimer: Not financial advice; if it were, it would have a more reassuring name.
